story.title: The Glass Archive
story.premise: Archivist Mara Vey uses a stolen founder ledger to expose the truth behind a memory-fed floating city before its floodgates turn the archives into a weapon.
story.tone: Intimate, tense, rain-soaked, and precise rather than bombastic.
styleGuide: Stay close to one viewpoint at a time.
Favor concrete sensory detail over abstract explanation.
Treat lore as pressure on the scene, not as exposition blocks.

notes.title: Mara Vey reads fractures but cannot rewrite memory
notes.summary: Mara is an archivist who can sense where preserved memories have been damaged, yet she cannot alter memorywater without breaking it.
notes.content: Mara Vey survives by treating records as living pressure points. She can feel where preserved memories buckle or split, but any attempt to rewrite them destroys evidence and leaves her physically shaken.
evidencePhrases: can sense fractures in preserved memories
cannot alter memorywater without breaking it
continuityConstraints: Mara Vey can interpret fractured memories but cannot rewrite memorywater.

notes.title: Ilyan Sorn protects the floodgates at personal cost
notes.summary: Ilyan maintains the floodgate engines beneath Orendale and hides evidence because he believes a public panic would kill more people than the truth alone.
notes.content: Ilyan Sorn knows the floodgate machinery better than anyone alive. He is pragmatic, ashamed of what he has concealed, and still protective of Mara even when he lies to her face.
evidencePhrases: public panic would kill more people
protective of Mara even when he lies
continuityConstraints: Ilyan Sorn's secrecy is protective and strategic, not cruel for its own sake.

notes.title: Sister Calis believes archives must be controlled, not freed
notes.summary: Calis leads the Lantern Chapter and argues that partial truth is safer than total disclosure when memory itself can destabilize the city.
notes.content: Sister Calis is disciplined and convinced that archives must remain under clerical control. She never sees herself as a villain; she sees herself as the last person still willing to contain chaos.
evidencePhrases: partial truth is safer than total disclosure
continuityConstraints: Sister Calis should sound morally certain, not cackling or theatrical.

notes.title: The Moonwell stores memorywater beneath the city
notes.summary: Orendale floats because the Moonwell cycles memorywater through the city ballast, but raw memorywater causes borrowed recollections and emotional bleed.
notes.content: Memorywater is both archive medium and civic infrastructure. Exposure to the raw flow pulls stray recollections into the body, leaving witnesses unsure which emotions are theirs.
continuityConstraints: Raw memorywater creates borrowed recollections and emotional bleed.

notes.title: The Founders' Accord forbids close blood kin from serving the same chamber
notes.summary: The city's oldest covenant bans close blood relatives from holding authority in the same civic chamber because family loyalties previously triggered archive tampering.
notes.content: The Founders' Accord is older than the current government and still shapes appointments. Violations are scandalous because they imply private loyalty is overruling public stewardship.
evidencePhrases: bans close blood relatives from holding authority in the same civic chamber
continuityConstraints: Close blood kin cannot openly serve the same chamber without political fallout.

notes.title: Lantern storms close the upper sky bridges at dusk
notes.summary: When the city's lantern storms roll in, upper sky bridges lock down and travel narrows to maintenance paths and cistern routes.
notes.content: Lantern storms are predictable but dangerous. Civilians avoid exposed bridges at dusk because the charged rain makes the lantern glass resonate hard enough to shatter railings.
evidencePhrases: upper sky bridges lock down at dusk
continuityConstraints: During a lantern storm, upper sky bridges are locked and dangerous.

notes.title: The founder ledger fragment points to a falsified floodgate report
notes.summary: The fragment Mara stole suggests the official inspection report was altered and that the drowned district is still connected to the live floodgate system.
notes.content: The ledger fragment contains a sequence code that should have been retired decades ago. Instead it reappears beside a maintenance seal from the current floodgate regime, implying deliberate falsification.
evidencePhrases: drowned district is still connected to the live floodgate system
continuityConstraints: The ledger fragment implicates a falsified floodgate report tied to the drowned district.

notes.title: Chapter eight hinges on a choice at the floodgates
notes.summary: Mara must decide whether to expose the falsified report immediately or let Ilyan finish a dangerous stabilization sequence before the truth becomes public.
notes.content: The scene should force a choice between moral clarity and practical survival. The most dramatic pressure point is not combat but whether Mara can trust Ilyan long enough to prevent a structural collapse.
evidencePhrases: choice between moral clarity and practical survival
continuityConstraints: The chapter eight confrontation should center on trust and timing, not random violence.

notes.title: The Northscript Vault feels damp, precise, and surveilled
notes.summary: The vault is lined with glass memory caskets, iron walkways, and rain-chilled ventilation shafts that make every whispered lie sound louder than it should.
notes.content: Northscript Vault is all cold metal, condensation, and careful labeling. The atmosphere should feel intimate and monitored, with small sounds carrying farther than expected.
evidencePhrases: small sounds carrying farther than expected
continuityConstraints: The vault should read as damp, precise, and surveilled.

notes.title: The Floodgate Engine Hall is loud enough to swallow easy conversation
notes.summary: The engine hall shakes with valve thunder, lit by brass gauges and memorywater glare, forcing characters to lean close or mishear one another.
notes.content: This setting should compress people together physically while making them work to communicate. Steam, brass, and reflected blue memorylight make the place feel industrial and dangerous without turning it into chaos.
evidencePhrases: forcing characters to lean close or mishear one another
continuityConstraints: The Floodgate Engine Hall should feel industrial, loud, and physically pressurized.

notes.title: Use close-third tension with sensory precision
notes.summary: The prose should stay close to the viewpoint, lean on tactile and acoustic detail, and avoid quippy banter or omniscient explanation.
notes.content: Preferred texture: rain on metal, breath in cold rooms, the weight of glass, restrained but lyrical syntax. Avoid modern slang, broad comedy, and generic fantasy grandstanding.
continuityConstraints: Voice stays intimate, sensory, and restrained rather than jokey or omniscient.

notes.title: Chapter seven ended with Mara stealing the ledger fragment
notes.summary: Mara escaped the vault through a rain cistern with the founder ledger fragment, leaving the Lantern Chapter aware that someone breached the casket hall.
notes.content: The previous chapter closes on escape, not safety. Mara is wet, exhausted, and carrying proof that is still only partial; the authorities know enough to tighten the city around her.
evidencePhrases: escaped the vault through a rain cistern
continuityConstraints: Chapter seven ends with escape, exhaustion, and partial proof rather than resolution.

notes.title: Trust between Mara and Ilyan is broken but not gone
notes.summary: Mara learned that Ilyan withheld crucial floodgate evidence, yet she also saw him divert blame to protect her from the Lantern Chapter's sweep.
notes.content: Their bond should feel frayed, not severed. Mara is furious about the lie, and Ilyan is carrying too much guilt to defend himself cleanly, which makes every exchange sharp but intimate.
evidencePhrases: bond should feel frayed, not severed
continuityConstraints: Mara and Ilyan should feel hurt and intimate at the same time; total indifference would be false.
